adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, if the parsed token payload lacks `refresh_token`, the code mutates the parsed data to `refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (line ~26). Call sites then persist this result into credentials: e.g. Office365 spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` and updates Prisma with it, and GoogleCalendarService assigns the return value of `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` to `key` and writes it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. This makes it verifiable from the diff that a literal placeholder refresh token can be stored, corrupting credential data.
